name: thebeangeek
description: TheBeanGeek is a specialty-coffee directory: browse coffees and roasteries with structured filters, see a roastery leaderboard, get personalized recommendations from your own review history, and log reviews - including photo-based user-contributed coffees.

interface.longDescription: TheBeanGeek is a specialty-coffee directory: browse coffees and roasteries with structured filters (no free-text search), see a roastery leaderboard, get personalized recommendations from your own review history, and log reviews for coffees - including ones not yet in the catalog, with an optional bag photo. The interactive workbench opens as a fullscreen app (My Coffee, Browse, and Review views) from the sidebar launcher or a conversation side panel, and roasteries can be @-mentioned in the composer. It only accesses your own TheBeanGeek account data.
defaultPrompt: Find me a fruity Ethiopian coffee for espresso.
What are the top roasteries right now?
Recommend coffees from my review history.

positive.description: Search for coffees by taste and origin, mapping natural language onto the structured filters.
positive.prompt: Find me a fruity Ethiopian coffee for espresso.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of Ethiopian coffees with fruity taste notes, suitable for espresso.

positive.description: Add a review for a known coffee, collecting the required fields before writing.
positive.prompt: I had a washed Ethiopian from Roast Coffee - rate it 4.5, brewed as espresso at home.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent collects anything missing (brew method and place are present; it asks about tastes, roast date, and note), then records the review and confirms the rating, brew method, and place.

positive.description: Review a coffee that is not in the catalog from an attached bag photo, uploading the photo and logging the user-contributed coffee.
positive.prompt: Attached a photo of the bag - it's Blueberry Pie from La Cabra. I brewed it as aeropress at home, 4.5.
positive.expected_behavior: The bag photo is uploaded first (uploadCoffeePhoto returns its URL), then the review is recorded on the named roastery's user-contributed coffee, queued outside the public catalog until approved.

positive.description: Personalized recommendations from the user's taste profile.
positive.prompt: Recommend some coffees based on my review history.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of recommended coffees derived from the user's taste profile; if the profile is not ready yet, the agent asks what they like and searches the catalog instead of retrying.

positive.description: Open the interactive workbench app, optionally pre-filtering the Browse view.
positive.prompt: Open my coffee app - I want to browse fruity espressos.
positive.expected_behavior: The TheBeanGeek workbench opens in fullscreen on the Browse view, pre-filtered to fruity, espresso-suitable coffees.

negative.description: Do not trigger for a destructive action that no tool supports.
negative.prompt: Delete my review from last week.

negative.description: Do not trigger for free-text search terms that cannot be mapped to structured filters.
negative.prompt: Find me something smooth and complex.

negative.description: Do not trigger a review write when the coffee has no identifying information.
negative.prompt: Review a coffee - it was good, 5 stars.

review.commerce_description: TheBeanGeek is a directory and review log; it does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: coffee and roastery directory search, roastery leaderboard, personalized recommendations, review logging including photo-based user-contributed coffees, and the interactive workbench app.
